title: Central terminology, versioned interpretation rules and safety constraints

requirements.RC-1063: same terminology key resolves consistently across surfaces
requirements.RC-1064: professional technical terms may remain untranslated
requirements.RC-1065: technical term and localized explanation can coexist
requirements.RC-1068: interpretation version is independent from calculation engine version
requirements.RC-1069: math changes cannot silently mutate interpretation catalog
requirements.RC-1070: every interpretation rule has explicit calculation condition
requirements.RC-1071: rule subject must match calculation subject
requirements.RC-1076: same sentence is not repeated uncontrolled
requirements.RC-1077: conflicting factors are not collapsed into an uncontrolled claim
requirements.RC-1079: calculated evidence and traditional interpretation are labeled separately
requirements.RC-1084: professional interpretation safety policy fails closed on unsafe certainty

promotion_policy: CI may promote NOT_STARTED to IMPLEMENTED only; editorial catalog QA, rendered TR/EN surfaces and exact-release evidence remain blockers.
